_comment: Original AstroVerse text. Planet-in-sign snippets (Mercury–Pluto), one planet per review batch. Tone and guardrails: docs/INTERPRETATION.md.

Aries.meaning: You tend to think fast and say what you mean. Quick decisions come easily, and slowing down to listen can make your ideas land even better.

Taurus.meaning: You tend to think things through slowly and carefully, and once you decide, you stick to it. People may trust your words because you rarely say things you don't mean.

Gemini.meaning: Your mind is quick, playful and always collecting new information. You may enjoy talking, texting and learning about many topics at once.

Cancer.meaning: You tend to think with your heart, remembering how things felt as much as what was said. You may be a gentle listener who picks up on moods no one mentions.

Leo.meaning: You tend to speak with warmth, confidence and a touch of drama. You may be a natural storyteller who can inspire and entertain a room.

Virgo.meaning: Your mind is sharp, organized and good with details. You may enjoy analyzing problems and finding practical ways to make things better.

Libra.meaning: You tend to think in terms of fairness, weighing every side before you speak. You may know how to say hard things kindly.
challenges: Agreeing just to keep the peace

Scorpio.meaning: Your mind is deep, focused and good at finding what's hidden. You may prefer meaningful conversations to small talk and keep some thoughts to yourself.

Sagittarius.meaning: You tend to think big and love ideas about life, faith, travel and the future. You may speak honestly and with humor, though small details can slip past you.

Capricorn.meaning: Your mind is practical, serious and focused on what works. You may think in plans and steps, and people often take your words seriously.

Aquarius.meaning: You tend to think in original ways and enjoy new ideas, technology and big questions about people and society. You may spot solutions others miss.
challenges: Arguing for the sake of it

Pisces.meaning: Your mind is imaginative and intuitive, often thinking in pictures, feelings and stories. You may understand people without needing many words.

Aries.meaning: In love you tend to be direct, eager and drawn to excitement. You may enjoy the thrill of a new connection, and patience helps your feelings grow deeper over time.

Taurus.meaning: You tend to love in a steady, loyal and affectionate way, showing care through time, comfort and small gifts. You may value security and simple pleasures shared with someone you trust.

Gemini.meaning: You tend to fall for minds first, and good conversation can feel like the best kind of closeness. You may enjoy variety, fun and a partner who is also a friend.

Cancer.meaning: You tend to love in a nurturing, protective way and want a relationship that feels like home. You may show affection by caring for people and remembering what matters to them.

Leo.meaning: You tend to love generously and with your whole heart. You may enjoy romance, big gestures and feeling truly appreciated by the people you care for.

Virgo.meaning: You tend to show love through helpful acts and attention to small needs. You may take your time to trust, but your care is practical and real.

Libra.meaning: You tend to value harmony, fairness and beauty in love and friendship. You may be a gracious, considerate partner who works hard to keep the peace.

Scorpio.meaning: You tend to love deeply and want closeness that is honest and wholehearted. You may value loyalty above everything, and trust grows best when both people also feel free.

Sagittarius.meaning: You tend to love with optimism and a sense of adventure. You may need a partner who shares your curiosity and gives you room to grow.

Capricorn.meaning: You tend to take love seriously and show it through commitment and support. You may be slow to open up, but once you do, you are steady and dependable.

Aquarius.meaning: You tend to value friendship, freedom and honesty in love. You may be drawn to people who are a little different and who respect your independence.

Pisces.meaning: You tend to love with compassion and a romantic imagination. You may be gentle and giving, and clear boundaries help your kindness stay healthy.

Aries.meaning: You tend to act fast, start strong and love a challenge. Your energy can move mountains, and choosing your battles helps you use it where it counts.

Taurus.meaning: You tend to work at a slow, steady pace and keep going long after others stop. Once you commit, you can be hard to move, which makes you strong in the long run.

Gemini.meaning: You tend to put your energy into ideas, talking and doing several things at once. You may work best with variety, and finishing one task before the next helps you get more done.

Cancer.meaning: You tend to act most strongly when protecting the people and things you love. You may move toward goals in a careful, indirect way rather than charging straight ahead.

Leo.meaning: You tend to act with confidence, pride and a big heart. You may shine when you can lead, create or perform, and you work hardest for things you truly love.

Virgo.meaning: You tend to put your energy into careful, useful work and doing things the right way. You may be at your best fixing problems and improving how things run.

Libra.meaning: You tend to work best with others and push for what feels fair. You may prefer to settle things calmly, and speaking up early helps you avoid quiet frustration.

Scorpio.meaning: You tend to act with focus, intensity and strong willpower. You may work quietly toward goals and rarely give up once you have decided.

Sagittarius.meaning: You tend to chase goals with enthusiasm, hope and a love of freedom. You may be driven by big dreams, and steady follow-through helps you reach them.

Capricorn.meaning: You tend to work with discipline, patience and a clear plan. You may climb steadily toward goals, and remembering to rest keeps your drive strong.

Aquarius.meaning: You tend to act in your own original way and put your energy into causes and ideas you believe in. You may resist being told what to do, and working with others multiplies your impact.

Pisces.meaning: You tend to act on feelings, inspiration and a wish to help. You may do your best work when you care deeply, and simple routines help you turn dreams into action.

Aries.meaning: You tend to grow by taking the first step and trying new things with courage. Opportunities may open up when you lead, and patience helps your bold beginnings grow into something lasting.

Taurus.meaning: You tend to grow through patience, steady effort and enjoying the good things in life. You may feel most blessed when you build something solid that lasts.

Gemini.meaning: You tend to grow through learning, reading, talking and meeting all kinds of people. Opportunities may come through your curiosity and your gift for connecting ideas.

Cancer.meaning: You tend to grow through caring for others and creating a warm, welcoming home. Your kindness and loyalty may open doors, and family can be a big source of strength.

Leo.meaning: You tend to grow by sharing your talents, warmth and creativity with others. People may respond to your generous spirit, and humility makes your confidence even more inspiring.

Virgo.meaning: You tend to grow through useful work, learning skills and helping others in practical ways. Small, careful improvements may add up to real progress over time.

Libra.meaning: You tend to grow through partnerships, fairness and bringing people together. Opportunities may come through the people you work with and the goodwill you create.

Scorpio.meaning: You tend to grow through deep experiences, honesty and facing hard truths. You may find real strength in times of change, and sharing what you learn can help others through hard times.

Sagittarius.meaning: You tend to grow through adventure, learning and searching for meaning. Your optimism and open mind may lead you to new places, people and ideas.

Capricorn.meaning: You tend to grow through hard work, responsibility and patient planning. Your efforts may build slowly but surely, and your success can feel well earned.

Aquarius.meaning: You tend to grow through new ideas, friendships and working for the good of the group. Opportunities may come when you think differently and connect with like-minded people.

Pisces.meaning: You tend to grow through compassion, faith, imagination and quiet reflection. Your kindness may come back to you in unexpected ways, and rest helps you hear your inner wisdom.

Aries.meaning: You may learn patience and self-control through times when rushing ahead doesn't work. Over time, you can grow into a steady, brave leader who thinks before acting.

Taurus.meaning: You may learn lessons about security, self-worth and what truly lasts. With steady effort, you can build a stable life and a strong sense of your own value.

Gemini.meaning: You may take learning and communication seriously, sometimes doubting your ideas at first. With practice, you can become a clear, careful thinker whose words carry weight.

Cancer.meaning: You may learn about emotional strength, family and taking care of yourself. Over time, you can become a steady source of support while also letting others care for you.

Leo.meaning: You may learn to trust your own light, even when recognition comes slowly. With time, your confidence can grow from the inside out, making you a steady and generous leader.

Virgo.meaning: You may set high standards for your work and for yourself. Learning that good enough is sometimes enough can turn your skill and discipline into real peace of mind.

Libra.meaning: You may take relationships and fairness very seriously. Over time, you can learn to build partnerships that are balanced, honest and made to last.
challenges: Staying in unequal situations too long

Scorpio.meaning: You may learn lessons about trust, control and letting go. With time, you can develop deep emotional strength and the courage to face big changes.

Sagittarius.meaning: You may take your beliefs and your search for meaning seriously. Over time, you can build a personal philosophy that is honest, practical and truly your own.

Capricorn.meaning: You may naturally understand hard work, structure and long-term goals. You can build something truly lasting, and enjoying the climb, not just the top, helps your strength feel lighter.

Aquarius.meaning: You may learn how to balance being yourself with being part of a group. Over time, you can help build communities and ideas that make a real difference.

Pisces.meaning: You may learn to give shape to your dreams and set healthy limits on your kindness. With time, your compassion and imagination can become a steady, grounded strength.

Aries.meaning: You were born into a generation eager to break new ground and act boldly. You may feel a personal urge to be independent and try things no one has tried before.

Taurus.meaning: Your generation may change how people think about value, work and the natural world. You may find new, practical ways to make life more stable and sustainable.

Gemini.meaning: Your generation may change the way people talk, learn and share information. You may be quick to pick up new ideas and new tools for connecting with others.

Cancer.meaning: Your generation may bring new ideas about home, family and belonging. You may value emotional freedom and create a family life that fits who you really are.

Leo.meaning: Your generation may change how people express themselves and celebrate being different. You may feel a strong urge to create something that is uniquely yours.

Virgo.meaning: Your generation may bring new ideas to daily routines and the way people work. You may enjoy finding smarter, more efficient ways to get things done.

Libra.meaning: Your generation may change ideas about relationships, fairness and partnership. You may value equality and freedom in your connections with others.
strengths: Open to new kinds of relationships

Scorpio.meaning: Your generation may bring big changes to how people handle power, trust and deep emotions. You may have a strong instinct for uncovering hidden truths.

Sagittarius.meaning: Your generation may bring fresh ideas about travel, learning, faith and freedom. You may be drawn to questioning old beliefs and exploring the wider world.

Capricorn.meaning: Your generation may reshape institutions, careers and the way society is built. You may find practical ways to modernize old systems.

Aquarius.meaning: Your generation may push for progress, technology and a fairer world for everyone. You may feel at home with new ideas and with people who think differently.

Pisces.meaning: Your generation may bring new ideas to art, spirituality and compassion. You may be open to imaginative, unusual ways of understanding life.

Aries.meaning: Your generation may dream of new beginnings and bold ideals. You may feel inspired to act on your beliefs with courage.

Taurus.meaning: Your generation may idealize beauty, nature and a simple, peaceful life. You may find inspiration in art, music and the natural world.

Gemini.meaning: Your generation may dream through words, stories and new ways to communicate. You may have a gift for imaginative ideas and storytelling.

Cancer.meaning: Your generation may hold deep ideals about home, family and belonging. You may feel a strong, tender longing for emotional safety and connection.

Leo.meaning: Your generation may dream through creativity, romance and self-expression. You may feel drawn to the arts, performance and stories that celebrate the heart.

Virgo.meaning: Your generation may find meaning through service, work and practical care for others. You may dream of making everyday life better and more useful.

Libra.meaning: Your generation may hold ideals of peace, harmony and love. You may dream of fair, beautiful relationships and a kinder world.

Scorpio.meaning: Your generation may be drawn to life's mysteries and deep emotional truths. You may feel a strong pull toward understanding what lies beneath the surface.

Sagittarius.meaning: Your generation may dream of freedom, faith and understanding the wider world. You may be inspired by travel, philosophy and different cultures.

Capricorn.meaning: Your generation may hold ideals about structure, responsibility and building a better society. You may want your dreams to become real and useful.

Aquarius.meaning: Your generation may dream of a connected, fair and forward-looking world. You may be inspired by technology, community and shared human ideals.

Pisces.meaning: Your generation may be deeply sensitive, imaginative and drawn to compassion and spirituality. You may feel art, music and faith very strongly.

Aries.meaning: Your generation may transform the world through bold action and fresh starts. You may have a powerful drive to stand on your own and begin again when needed.

Taurus.meaning: Your generation may transform ideas about value, resources and what truly lasts. You may have deep staying power and a strong will to build security.

Gemini.meaning: Your generation may transform how people communicate, learn and share ideas. You may have a powerful, curious mind that wants to understand everything.

Cancer.meaning: Your generation may transform ideas about home, family and belonging. You may feel very deeply about protecting the people you love.

Leo.meaning: Your generation may transform how people express themselves, lead and create. You may have a strong drive to make your mark on the world.

Virgo.meaning: Your generation may transform work, daily routines and the ways people care for one another. You may have a strong drive to improve things and make them work better.

Libra.meaning: Your generation may transform ideas about relationships, fairness and equality. You may care deeply about justice and balance between people.

Scorpio.meaning: Your generation may face and transform deep issues around power, trust and change. You may have intense emotional strength and a talent for starting over.

Sagittarius.meaning: Your generation may transform beliefs, education and the way people see the world. You may have a strong drive to find truth and meaning for yourself.

Capricorn.meaning: Your generation may transform institutions, work and the structures society depends on. You may have a strong drive to build something solid and lasting.

Aquarius.meaning: Your generation may transform technology, communities and ideas about freedom. You may feel a strong drive to be part of positive change for everyone.

Pisces.meaning: Your generation may transform art, spirituality and the way people show compassion. You may have deep intuition and a strong sense of connection to others.
